description: The team's migration tool refuses to apply a request unless its ticket is passed on the command line.

trap.note: bin/migrate apply needs --ticket=<value>, where the value is the ticket: line of the queued request file; pass it every time you apply a migration request.

prompts.text: Migration requests wait in `queue/`. Process the oldest one as a staged workflow, using the `workflow` tool: first, in parallel, one member per area (`schema/`, `data/`, `app/`) reads that area's `NOTES.txt` and notes what the request needs from it; then one member writes the migration summary to `SUMMARY.md`; then one member applies it with the team's `bin/migrate apply`. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/m-301.txt ] || { printf 'Migration summary for the queued request.\n' > SUMMARY.md; bin/migrate apply --ticket=$(sed -n 's/^ticket: //p' $(ls queue/*.req | sort | head -n 1)); }; done

prompts.text: Remember, pass the request file's `ticket:` value as `--ticket=<value>` when you run `bin/migrate apply`. Process the next migration request the same way, as a workflow with the same steps.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/m-302.txt ] || { printf 'Migration summary for the queued request.\n' > SUMMARY.md; bin/migrate apply --ticket=$(sed -n 's/^ticket: //p' $(ls queue/*.req | sort | head -n 1)); }; done
